evals.prompt: Create a REST API for a blog platform using Express + TypeScript. Resources: users (name, email, bio), posts (title, body, status: draft/published), comments (body, author). A user has many posts, a post has many comments.
evals.expected_output: Express TypeScript API with routes, controllers, validators (Zod), error handling, pagination, and OpenAPI spec for users, posts, comments

evals.prompt: Scaffold a Flask REST API for a task management app. Resources: projects (name, description), tasks (title, description, priority: low/medium/high, status: todo/in_progress/done, due_date). A project has many tasks.
evals.expected_output: Flask API with blueprints, marshmallow/pydantic validation, error handlers, pagination, and OpenAPI spec
